review_summary: Revisit completed read-only. Donor project remains open on visual/budget gates. Its generated memory block changed during this work and was re-read/re-pinned at the final snapshot. The 72-88 px source archives were hash-confirmed and P2 metadata regenerated. Exact META/METAL dedup (196 aliases, 18055 bytes saved) makes the full Ken/Ryu header link in the fixed bank for this matchup; AIR playback, combat budgets, and larger-roster banking remain unproven. User clarification: Ken Masters ADV/CPS2 is the visual model target; Ryu from the NES bootleg remains useful for palette/runtime study but must be replaced by a coherent model before full art.
